description: This file defines a base class 'DumpReader' for handling breakpad crash dump files, including methods for managing crash dumps and retrieving crash information.

classes.name: DumpReader
classes.description: Base class for breakpad dump readers, providing interface and common functionality for crash dump processing.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes DumpReader with host and build directory.

methods.name: check_is_functional
methods.description: Abstract method to check if the dump reader is functional.

methods.name: crash_dumps_directory
methods.description: Returns the directory path for crash dumps.

methods.name: clobber_old_results
methods.description: Removes old crash dump results if the directory exists.

methods.name: look_for_new_crash_logs
methods.description: Searches for new crash logs for given crashed processes since start_time.

methods.name: _get_pid_from_dump
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve PID from a dump file.

methods.name: _get_stack_from_dump
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve stack trace from a dump file.

methods.name: _file_extension
methods.description: Abstract method to return the file extension for dump files.
